movie_title: How culture affects sadness ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: How does culture influence the way you feel and show sadness? Neil and Sam will be investigating how

vocabulary.definition: a group of words established by usage as having a meaning not deducible from those of the individual words
vocabulary.example: Learning idioms in a new language can be challenging but fun.

vocabulary.definition: unable to show your true feelings and emotions
vocabulary.example: She had a repressed childhood, always hiding her emotions.

vocabulary.definition: a type of intense and thoughtful sadness
vocabulary.example: The rainy weather outside added to his sense of melancholy.

vocabulary.definition: a strong sadness usually caused by someone's death
vocabulary.example: The whole family was overwhelmed with grief after the loss of their pet.

vocabulary.definition: unhappy, bored, or tired of something, especially if it's been happening a long time
vocabulary.example: I'm fed up with the constant noise from the construction site next door.

vocabulary.definition: to not show your feelings when you're upset, even though it is difficult not to
vocabulary.example: He tried to keep a stiff upper lip during the funeral, but tears welled up in his eyes.
